title: Redo the Cake
lines: Meg had a plan to make a cake.
She mixed it up and set it to bake.
But the cake came out flat and sad.
Dad said, "You did not preheat it."
Meg had to redo the whole cake.
This time she did preheat it first.
The cake got tall. Meg had a grin.

questions.ask: What went wrong with the first cake?
questions.listenFor: It came out flat, because she did not preheat. Have them find the word preheat.

questions.ask: What did Meg do the next time?
questions.listenFor: She did preheat it first, and the cake got tall. Both parts.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg will forget to preheat again? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer. Listen for a reason - the flat cake, or the grin at the end.
